corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez text clearly shows the contracted suffix form ወለአንስትዮሙ (with ዮ), not ወለአንስትያሆሙ.
The 2nd-order vowel mark on ቹ is clearly visible in ሴቶቹንም, matching the parallel ወንዶቹንም.
Classical Ge'ez plural passive participle with pronominal suffix requires the 4th-order ሐ (ሙቁሐኒሆሙ), which is what is printed on the page.
The printed Ge'ez verb is ተጸለላ (3rd person feminine plural agreeing with አዕይንትየ), followed by a word-space colon that was misread with the preceding ላ as ልኩ.
